summary: Refined system architecture by integrating probabilistic data structures, optimizing parsing logic via the Chomsky Hierarchy, and implementing DFA-based regex engines to ensure linear performance. These efforts, tracked against the 1% architectural output metric, now include semantic deduplication to maintain high-density, non-redundant knowledge storage.
key_learnings: Layering probabilistic filters before deterministic logic optimizes throughput.
Complexity-aware guardrails and DFA-based patterns prevent catastrophic performance failures.
Matching parsing tools to language complexity prevents pipeline failures.
Semantic deduplication via cosine similarity is essential for preventing knowledge base bloat.
Architectural progress is best measured by focusing the 1% growth metric on high-density, non-redundant structural output.
